text: The prince who relies entirely on fortune is lost when it changes. I believe also that he will be successful who directs his actions according to the spirit of the times, and that he whose actions do not accord with the times will not be successful.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XXV, What fortune can effect in human affairs and how to withstand her
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
